blocks.name: plant
blocks.description: Dispatch hot and chilled water demand to the heat pump, boiler and chiller.

blocks.name: one
blocks.notes: Represents 100% of the heating or cooling request.

blocks.name: backup_fraction
blocks.notes: Calculates the share left for boiler and chiller after heat pump allocation.

blocks.name: heat_pump_heating
blocks.notes: Assigns the selected share of hot-water demand to the heat pump.

blocks.name: heat_pump_cooling
blocks.notes: Assigns the selected share of chilled-water demand to the heat pump.

blocks.name: boiler
blocks.notes: Meets the remaining hot-water demand with the boiler.

blocks.name: chiller
blocks.notes: Meets the remaining chilled-water demand with the chiller.
Shared four-pipe plant: the heat pump serves a configurable fraction of heating and cooling demand; boiler and chiller cover the remainder.

blocks.name: ahu_1
blocks.description: Supply air temperature reset, fan speed, and coil valve control.

outputs.name: pressure_request_count
outputs.label: Zone Duct Pressure Reset Request Count

blocks.name: cold_threshold
blocks.notes: Below 12 °C outdoors, the AHU uses its warm-up supply temperature.

blocks.name: warm_threshold
blocks.notes: Above 25 °C outdoors, the AHU uses its cooling supply temperature.

blocks.name: warmup_supply
blocks.notes: 18 °C supply air is selected in cold weather.

blocks.name: mild_supply
blocks.notes: 16 °C supply air is selected in mild weather.

blocks.name: cooling_supply
blocks.notes: 14 °C supply air is selected in warm weather.

blocks.name: is_cold
blocks.notes: Compares outdoor temperature with the cold-weather threshold.

blocks.name: is_mild
blocks.notes: Compares outdoor temperature with the warm-weather threshold.

blocks.name: mild_or_cool
blocks.notes: Selects 16 °C or 14 °C supply air for mild or warm weather.

blocks.name: supply_reset
blocks.notes: Selects warm-up supply air in cold weather; otherwise uses the mild/warm result.

blocks.name: fan_gain
blocks.notes: Airflow feedforward allows startup while the duct-pressure PI loop takes control.

blocks.name: fan_limit
blocks.notes: Zero minimum fan command permits shutdown when all zone airflow requests fall to zero.

blocks.name: minimum_outdoor_air
blocks.notes: Fallback outdoor-air fraction when economizing is disabled; the measured-flow minimum loop may raise it.

blocks.name: coil_zero
blocks.notes: Closes a heating or cooling valve when its mode is not needed.

blocks.name: heating_coil_error
blocks.notes: Finds how much warmer the supply target is than measured mixed air.

blocks.name: heating_coil_feedforward
blocks.notes: Converts a 20 K full-open coil temperature rise into a valve fraction.

blocks.name: heating_coil_feedback
blocks.notes: Trims the heating valve from measured supply-air temperature.

blocks.name: heating_coil_sum
blocks.notes: Combines feedforward and measured-temperature correction.

blocks.name: heating_coil_limit
blocks.notes: Keeps the heating valve within its physical 0–100% travel.

blocks.name: heating_coil_needed
blocks.notes: Enables heating only when mixed air is below the supply target.

blocks.name: heating_coil_enable
blocks.notes: Closes the heating valve when heating is not needed.

blocks.name: cooling_coil_error
blocks.notes: Finds how much warmer mixed air is than the supply target.

blocks.name: cooling_coil_feedforward
blocks.notes: Converts a 20 K full-open coil temperature drop into a valve fraction.

blocks.name: cooling_coil_feedback
blocks.notes: Trims the cooling valve from measured supply-air temperature.

blocks.name: cooling_coil_sum
blocks.notes: Combines feedforward and measured-temperature correction.

blocks.name: cooling_coil_limit
blocks.notes: Keeps the cooling valve within its physical 0–100% travel.

blocks.name: cooling_coil_needed
blocks.notes: Enables cooling only when mixed air is above the supply target.

blocks.name: cooling_coil_enable
blocks.notes: Closes the cooling valve when cooling is not needed.

blocks.name: request_sum_1
blocks.notes: Adds qualified integer VAV pressure requests for this AHU.

blocks.name: request_sum_2
blocks.notes: Adds qualified integer VAV pressure requests for this AHU.

blocks.name: request_sum_3
blocks.notes: Adds qualified integer VAV pressure requests for this AHU.

blocks.name: request_sum_4
blocks.notes: Adds qualified integer VAV pressure requests for this AHU.

blocks.name: ignored_request_count
blocks.notes: Ignore the first two zone requests before increasing the pressure target.

blocks.name: request_count_real
blocks.notes: Convert integer zone request count for the continuous reset calculation.

blocks.name: ignored_request_real
blocks.notes: Convert ignored integer requests for subtraction.

blocks.name: excess_request_count
blocks.notes: Subtract ignored requests from the measured zone request count.

blocks.name: zero_requests
blocks.notes: Only requests above the ignored count trigger a response.

blocks.name: positive_request_count
blocks.notes: Clamp excess requests to zero.

blocks.name: response_per_request
blocks.notes: Raise normalized pressure by 0.05 per request above the ignored count each sample.

blocks.name: maximum_response
blocks.notes: Cap each sample's total pressure response.

blocks.name: bounded_response
blocks.notes: Limit the total response in one sample.

blocks.name: trim_amount
blocks.notes: Trim pressure down when requests do not justify a response.

blocks.name: net_pressure_reset
blocks.notes: Combine the trim with the bounded response.

blocks.name: request_delay
blocks.notes: Hold the initial pressure target for ten minutes after the fan is requested.

blocks.name: initial_pressure_target
blocks.notes: Initial pressure setpoint when fan starts or is off.

blocks.name: low_pressure_target
blocks.notes: Minimum normalized duct pressure target.

blocks.name: high_pressure_target
blocks.notes: Maximum normalized duct pressure target.

blocks.name: pressure_previous
blocks.notes: Hold the previous sampled pressure target; this state breaks the trim-and-respond feedback loop.

blocks.name: pressure_target_sum
blocks.notes: Apply this sample's net reset to the previous pressure target.

blocks.name: pressure_above_minimum
blocks.notes: Limit pressure target to the editable minimum.

blocks.name: pressure_below_maximum
blocks.notes: Limit pressure target to the editable maximum.

blocks.name: pressure_candidate
blocks.notes: Hold the initial target until fan run time exceeds the reset delay.

blocks.name: pressure_target_output
blocks.notes: Expose the sampled target only after the reset delay.

blocks.name: duct_pressure_pi
blocks.notes: Modulate fan speed to measured normalized duct pressure.

blocks.name: fan_feedforward_max
blocks.notes: Use the larger of airflow feedforward and duct-pressure PI fan commands.

blocks.name: fan_request_threshold
blocks.notes: Keep the fan off when the AHU has no airflow request.

blocks.name: fan_requested
blocks.notes: Enable the fan when requested airflow exceeds the off threshold.

blocks.name: fan_off
blocks.notes: Zero fan speed when no VAV requests air.

blocks.name: fan_enable
blocks.notes: Gate the fan command with actual VAV airflow demand.

blocks.name: minimum_oa_flow_gain
blocks.notes: Set a teaching minimum of 20% of AHU requested airflow as outside air; not yet ASHRAE 62.1 calculation.

blocks.name: minimum_oa_pi
blocks.notes: Increase outside-air damper command when measured flow misses its minimum setpoint.

blocks.name: minimum_oa_command
blocks.notes: Apply the greater of economizer and minimum outside-air flow commands.

blocks.name: economizer_mixed_air_pi
blocks.notes: Modulate outside-air fraction from measured mixed-air temperature and the supply-air target while economizing.

blocks.name: economizer_low_limit
blocks.notes: Conservative low-temperature guard for this simplified mixed-air model; not a G36 freeze-protection sequence.

blocks.name: outdoor_below_return
blocks.notes: Outdoor air can cool the return air.

blocks.name: return_above_supply_target
blocks.notes: The AHU calls for cooling relative to return air.

blocks.name: outdoor_above_low_limit
blocks.notes: Avoid low-temperature economizer operation.

blocks.name: free_cooling_useful
blocks.notes: Temperature conditions allow free cooling.

blocks.name: economizer_temperature_ok
blocks.notes: Outdoor air stays above the low limit while the fan is requested.

blocks.name: economizer_enabled
blocks.notes: Enable mixed-air temperature modulation when all conditions hold.

blocks.name: outdoor_air_select
blocks.notes: Select the modulating economizer fraction while enabled.

Serves five VAV zones. Outdoor temperature chooses the supply-air target. Measured mixed and supply temperatures drive editable heating and cooling coil valve loops; total airflow request sets fan speed. An editable mixed-air PI loop modulates outdoor air when temperature conditions permit free cooling; minimum outside-air flow has priority.

blocks.notes: G36 occupied cooling setpoint: 24 °C.

blocks.name: heat_setpoint
blocks.notes: G36 occupied heating setpoint: 21 °C.

blocks.name: cool_deadband
blocks.notes: Cooling starts only after the room exceeds its setpoint by 0.5 °C.

blocks.name: zero
blocks.notes: Shared zero signal for disabled reheat and the heating-mode comparison.

blocks.name: minimum_damper
blocks.notes: Keeps the damper at least 15% open for ventilation.

blocks.name: minimum_airflow
blocks.notes: Base airflow estimate before pressure and damper effects are added.

blocks.name: cool_error
blocks.notes: Positive when the room is warmer than the cooling setpoint.

blocks.name: heat_error
blocks.notes: Positive when the room is colder than the heating setpoint.

blocks.name: cooling_mode
blocks.notes: Checks whether cooling error exceeds the 0.5 °C deadband.

blocks.name: heating_mode
blocks.notes: Enables reheat only when room temperature is below the heating setpoint.

blocks.name: air_can_cool
blocks.notes: Checks that supply air is cooler than the room before opening for cooling.

blocks.name: cooling_enabled
blocks.notes: Both a warm room and useful cool supply air are required to open the damper.

blocks.name: cool_pi
blocks.notes: PI loop turns room temperature error into a damper increment, capped at 85%.

blocks.name: heat_pi
blocks.notes: Reverse-acting PI loop turns low room temperature into a reheat command.

blocks.name: damper_offset
blocks.notes: Adds the minimum ventilation position to the cooling PI command.

blocks.name: damper_limit

notes: Compare this sample with FourPipeBuildingControls using the same weather, equipment, and physical model. Each zone has a debounced Brick occupancy sensor. Occupied setpoints are 21/24 °C, standby widens them by 0.5 K, and unoccupied setpoints are 16/32 °C. Ventilation minimums and AHU fan minimums also reset. A six-hour preconditioning window requests occupied temperature setpoints before scheduled occupancy. The AHUs use outdoor/return temperature comparisons and measured mixed-air feedback to modulate free cooling. Measured primary airflow and discharge temperature feed an editable terminal reheat temperature limit and two timed teaching alarms. This is a G36-inspired subset; full G36 economizer limits, plant coordination, alarms, and CO2 sequences are not modeled.
